records.problem_signature: Low disk space with measured temporary-file cache growth.
observed_evidence: Diagnostic report names temp/cache paths and measured reclaimable bytes.
records.solution_pattern: Offer cleanup only for envelope-declared temp/cache locations after consent.
applicability_limits: Does not apply to unknown user data directories
records.rollback_or_reversal: Cleanup paths are listed in the report; no registry or boot mutation is included.
records.verification_method: Re-scan the paths and compare reclaimed byte count.
